# TEU / TFEU — Key Articles Index for Legislative and Enforcement Work

Curated static reference for the `eu-legislative` skills (`lawyer-secgen`,
`subsidiarity-checker`, `trilogue-position-tracker`), `eu-competition`
(`lawyer-legal-service`) and `eu-grants-enforcement` (`lfn-drafter`,
`transposition-tracker`). An index of the treaty articles these skills cite
most — **not** the authentic text. All article summaries:
`[EUR-Lex — verify current version]` (consolidated treaties, CELEX 12016ME/TXT).

Cite as: `(Art. X TFEU/TEU — EUR-Lex 12016ME) [EUR-Lex — verify current version]`.

---

## Foundations (TEU)

| Art. | Content |
|---|---|
| 4(3) TEU | **Sincere cooperation** — Member States take any appropriate measure to fulfil Treaty obligations; basis of many infringement arguments |
| 5 TEU | **Conferral (5(1)–(2)), subsidiarity (5(3)), proportionality (5(4))** — in areas of non-exclusive competence the Union acts "only if and in so far as the objectives… cannot be sufficiently achieved by the Member States… but can rather, by reason of the scale or effects… be better achieved at Union level"; content and form of action "shall not exceed what is necessary". Applied per **Protocol No 2** — see `references/subsidiarity-protocol.md` |
| 13–17 TEU | Institutions; **17 TEU**: Commission's right of initiative, guardian of the Treaties |
| 16(4)–(5) TEU | **QMV definition** (55 % of Council members, ≥ 15, representing 65 % of population; blocking minority ≥ 4) — also the comitology examination-procedure majority |

## Competences (TFEU Arts. 2–6)

| Art. | Content |
|---|---|
| 2–3 | Categories; **exclusive**: customs union, competition rules for the internal market, euro monetary policy, marine conservation, common commercial policy (+ certain international agreements) |
| 4 | **Shared**: internal market, social policy aspects, cohesion, agriculture/fisheries, environment, consumer protection, transport, energy, AFSJ, public-health safety aspects |
| 5–6 | Coordinating / supporting competences (employment; health, industry, culture, education…) |

## Most-used legal bases (TFEU)

| Art. | Basis for | Procedure |
|---|---|---|
| 43(2) | Agriculture and fisheries | OLP |
| 53(1) (+62) | Mutual recognition, services, professional qualifications | OLP |
| 91 / 100(2) | Transport | OLP |
| **114** | **Internal-market approximation** — the default harmonisation basis; limits per *Tobacco Advertising* (see `references/cjeu-legal-basis.md`) | OLP |
| 115 | Approximation directly affecting the internal market (directives only) | Special — unanimity, EP consulted |
| 113 | Indirect taxation harmonisation | Special — unanimity, EP consulted |
| 153 | Social policy | OLP (mostly) |
| 168(4) | Public health (defined safety aspects) | OLP |
| 192 | **Environment** (191 objectives) | OLP; 192(2) unanimity niches (fiscal, town planning, energy mix) |
| 194(2) | Energy | OLP; fiscal measures unanimity |
| 207 | **Common commercial policy** | OLP; agreements via Art. 218 |
| 79 / 82–83 | Migration; judicial cooperation in criminal matters (incl. **83(2)** approximation; note the lowered yellow-card threshold for Art. 76 acts) | OLP |
| **352** | Flexibility clause — action necessary within Union policies, no specific powers provided | Unanimity + EP consent; cannot extend competences (*Opinion 2/94*) |

## Legal acts and law-making (TFEU Arts. 288–294)

| Art. | Content |
|---|---|
| 288 | **Regulation** (general application, binding in entirety, directly applicable) · **directive** (binding as to result, national choice of form/methods) · **decision** · recommendations/opinions (non-binding) |
| 289 | Legislative acts = adopted by legislative procedure (ordinary / special) |
| **290** | **Delegated acts** — delegation of power to supplement/amend non-essential elements; objectives, content, scope, duration must be explicitly defined; essential elements reserved |
| **291** | **Implementing acts** — uniform conditions for implementation; 291(3) is the basis of Reg. 182/2011 — see `references/comitology-reg-182-2011.md` |
| 293 | Council may amend a Commission proposal only by unanimity; Commission may alter/withdraw its proposal while Council has not acted |
| **294** | **OLP stages**: Commission proposal → EP first reading (no deadline) → Council first reading (no deadline; adoption if EP position approved) → EP second reading (**3 months**, +1 extension: approve/reject/amend by majority of component members) → Council second reading (**3 months**, +1) → **Conciliation Committee** convened within 6 weeks (joint text within **6 weeks**) → third reading (**6 weeks** each). Early agreement at any reading = trilogue practice |

## Enforcement (TFEU Arts. 258–260)

| Art. | Content |
|---|---|
| **258** | Commission infringement procedure: **letter of formal notice → reasoned opinion → CJEU referral** if the Member State fails to comply within the deadline set |
| 259 | Member State v Member State (after seising the Commission) |
| **260(1)–(2)** | Failure to comply with a judgment → second referral; Commission specifies **lump sum and/or penalty payment**; no reasoned opinion needed (LFN suffices) |
| **260(3)** | **Non-communication of transposition measures** for a legislative-procedure directive: financial sanctions may be requested **already in the first Art. 258 referral**, up to the amount the Commission specifies |

## Judicial review and references (TFEU)

| Art. | Content |
|---|---|
| **263** | Annulment — grounds: lack of competence, infringement of essential procedural requirements, infringement of the Treaties or any rule of law relating to their application, misuse of powers; **2-month** time limit; standing: privileged applicants, and natural/legal persons (direct + individual concern; regulatory acts — direct concern, no implementing measures) |
| 265 | Failure to act |
| **267** | Preliminary rulings — interpretation and validity; courts of last instance must refer (*CILFIT* limits) |
| 277 | Plea of illegality |
| 340 | Non-contractual liability |
